title: OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
description: RFC 9728 protected resource metadata, with the fields Poppy needs. The Company's domain publishes it at https://{domain}/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource with resource exactly https://{domain}, and authorization_servers names its issuer (spec 3.2). A listed MCP server publishes it with resource set to its URL and the Company's issuer in authorization_servers (spec 7), as does any service that accepts only tokens issued for it (spec 4.5). Other fields are allowed.
